title: Factoring the Matrix of Domination: A Critical Review and Reimagination of Intersectionality in AI Fairness
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a critical literature review on intersectionality in AI fairness and does not conduct any benchmark measurements related to faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze or discuss religion or faith. Its focus is on how the concept of intersectionality, primarily concerning race and gender, is used and often misconstrued within the AI fairness literature.
